_comment: 'Centralized internal directory for streamlined communication across
institutional departments. Structured contact details and departmental
routing for Customer Service, Finance, Loan Department, and Management.'
Implemented as a Fineract datatable rather than a new database table, which means
no backend code and no schema migration. A datatable is a user-defined table that
Fineract exposes over the REST API automatically and renders in the stock admin UI,
so FETAN can add and edit contacts themselves without a developer.
Attached to m_office because a multi-branch SACCO needs a Finance contact per
branch, not one for the whole organisation. multiRow allows several contacts per
branch. Head Office rows act as the organisation-wide entries.
Department is a dropdown backed by a code, so the four departments stay
consistent instead of being retyped and misspelled per branch.
